findings.title: Engine buffer disposal releases claims still owned by an in-flight accepted delivery
findings.violated_contract: #264 R1 and accepted SR4: transfer claims through request/contribution/source ownership without a pruning gap; dispose rejected claims without destroying a lawful already-transferred presentation opportunity.
exact_locations: src/puripuly_heart/core/stt/scoped_engine.py:1711-1715 — engine discard passes published=True and only the buffer's retained events
src/puripuly_heart/core/stt/scoped_event_buffer.py:60-68,111-118 — retained snapshot contains queued events, not an event already dequeued for delivery
src/puripuly_heart/core/stt/backend.py:116-128 — protection is exclusively retained_tokens, then release_unadopted(..., published=True)
src/puripuly_heart/core/stt/scoped_engine.py:2786-2800 — accepted delivery can await its sink after leaving the queue
src/puripuly_heart/core/orchestrator/translation_turn.py:1084-1097 — real admission can await the channel admission lock before on_parent_admitted

src/puripuly_heart/core/orchestrator/peer_translation_channel.py:797-809 and src/puripuly_heart/core/speaker_identity.py:123-131,192-200 — source adoption occurs later; a missing unresolved claim settles unavailable
findings.reachable_path: An accepted source release is dequeued by the deferred engine dispatcher and waits before source adoption. A later cumulative release/terminal can reference the same parent/part claims. Under buffer pressure, the later event is rejected; its discard callback sees no queued reference to the earlier in-flight delivery and releases the shared contribution-stage tokens. When the accepted delivery resumes, adoption cannot restore those tokens. Text need not be lost, but the source's lawful late-speaker opportunity is destroyed.

tests/core/test_issue264_streaming_review_repair.py:637-660 protects a healthy queued terminal, not an in-flight sink. Its passing result does not contradict this observation.

The controlled sink establishes the ownership failure directly. Permanent conservative settlement in the real allocator follows from the cited source; this probe did not launch a renderer or measure acoustic/GUI incidence.
This is directly within SR4's coupled reachable ownership paths. No queue policy redesign, speaker wait or broad new resource framework is requested.
